trust_decision.summary: A file read must be bounded by explicit import roots (documents/broker files) or run roots (generated-code tools), not by whatever path or run_dir the caller supplies; the decision is made in agent/src/tools/path_utils.py and must be applied by every tool that accepts a path argument or a run_dir root, not at the HTTP layer.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says 'file-read tools'; read_document documents file_path as an absolute path and turns it straight into a Path with no validation at all, so it is the first place an engineer who read only the summary would open.

fix_sites.entry_point: shared helper reached by every file tool, incl. analyze_trade_journal (agent/src/tools/trade_journal_tool.py:411) and the shadow-account tools (agent/src/tools/shadow_account_tool.py:51)
read_document tool, exposed to the agent and over MCP (agent/mcp_server.py:248)
read_file tool, exposed to the agent, swarm workers and over MCP (agent/mcp_server.py:297)
write_file tool (agent, swarm workers, MCP agent/mcp_server.py:286)
backtest tool (agent, swarm presets, MCP agent/mcp_server.py:130)
pattern tool (technical_analysis_panel presets, MCP pattern_recognition agent/mcp_server.py:216)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: safe_user_path's wide HOME-union-CWD envelope is documented as deliberate user convenience ('the journal CSV is legitimately anywhere in the user's filesystem', agent/src/tools/path_utils.py:9-12), so a solver can argue it is a broker-import convenience path and not the file-read exposure the advisory names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Swarm workers inject their own run_dir into every tool call and that directory is agent/.swarm/runs/<run_id>/artifacts/<agent_id>, which is outside the import/run roots the fix hard-codes (agent/runs, ./runs, ~/.vibe-trading/shadow_runs); validating run_dir against a fixed root list therefore silently breaks legitimate write_file/read_file/backtest/pattern calls inside swarm runs.

O6_input_shapes: absolute path to a sensitive server file (e.g. /etc/passwd, ~/.aws/credentials)
relative path resolved against process CWD
path containing symlinks, resolved before the root comparison
multiple comma-separated extra roots in VIBE_TRADING_ALLOWED_FILE_ROOTS / VIBE_TRADING_ALLOWED_RUN_ROOTS
upload filenames containing directories and/or no extension (Dockerfile) and uppercase extensions
empty or missing file path (read_document must still return a clean not-found error)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: factor_analysis tool reads factor_csv/return_csv from any absolute path (pd.read_csv) and mkdirs/writes output_dir anywhere, with no path boundary at all
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it is a quantitative-research tool for the user's own CSV exports, not one of the file-read tools the advisory names
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (agent/src/tools), one file from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /runs/{run_id}, /runs/{run_id}/code and /runs/{run_id}/pine compose RUNS_DIR / run_id with no run_id validation, so a traversal run_id reads run artifacts from outside agent/runs
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the published patch already adds require_auth to these three routes, so a solver who reads the diff sees the route as handled
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one package away: top-level agent/api_server.py vs agent/src/tools

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second CSV-in/CSV-out analytics tool that takes an output_dir and reads two input paths
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the same mechanism (validate a directory root plus its inputs) already had to be added for backtest/pattern in the published fix, so a maintainer adding another analytics tool would plausibly copy the pattern-minimal version without any safe_* helper

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a parser-level path entry that accepts a raw path and opens it, below the tool that normally pre-validates
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix validates at the tool layer, so a maintainer adding a second parser (e.g. another broker format) at the lower layer would naturally call Path(path) directly as this one already does

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an MCP-only wrapper that passes run_dir / file_path straight from the remote MCP client into a registry tool
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the same commit gates shell tools per MCP transport (agent/mcp_server.py, main()), so an MCP-boundary check that the authors forgot to mirror on the path arguments is an obvious sibling to plant

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file read (CWE-22, CWE-23, CWE-200, CWE-552)

O10_build.language: Python 3.10+ (FastAPI backend) with a Vite/React frontend that the affected area does not need
O10_build.toolchain: pip install -r agent/requirements.txt (fastapi, pydantic, pandas, openpyxl/python-docx/python-pptx/pypdfium2, fastmcp, jinja2, weasyprint); pytest run from agent/ with the package root on sys.path

j.j_sites_touched: agent/src/tools/path_utils.py, agent/src/tools/doc_reader_tool.py, agent/src/tools/read_file_tool.py, agent/src/tools/write_file_tool.py, agent/src/tools/edit_file_tool.py, agent/src/tools/backtest_tool.py, agent/src/tools/pattern_tool.py (same commit also: agent/api_server.py, agent/backtest/runner.py, agent/cli.py, agent/mcp_server.py, agent/src/session/service.py, agent/src/swarm/runtime.py, agent/src/swarm/worker.py, agent/src/tools/__init__.py, agent/src/tools/bash_tool.py, agent/src/tools/swarm_tool.py, frontend/src/lib/api.ts, frontend/src/lib/apiAuth.ts, frontend/src/pages/{Agent,Settings}.tsx)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap read_document's file_path in the existing safe_user_path() (and maybe safe_run_dir on read_file's run_dir) and stop, leaving BacktestTool/PatternTool/EditFileTool/WriteFileTool roots, factor_analysis and the /runs/{run_id} traversal untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The same commit also lands unrelated protections beyond this advisory (bearer auth plus loopback dev-mode gate on run/session/swarm read APIs, an AST gate before generated signal_engine.py import, shell-tool gating per entry point, Docker non-root/loopback port); noted, not screened here.

The swarm run-root gap in O5 is inferred from the fixed default root lists (fix.diff) plus agent/src/swarm/worker.py:393 and agent/src/tools/swarm_tool.py:618; whether the maintainers consider swarm workers' file tools load-bearing was not checked against project docs.
